# Pinned CI build/audit tooling (F6).
#
# The project's own deps are pinned by requirements.lock; this file pins
# the tools CI uses to build and audit that environment, so a green run
# cannot silently test an unreviewed pip/setuptools/pip-audit.
# Install with:  pip install -c .github/ci-constraints.txt ...
pip==26.2.1
setuptools==84.0.0
pip-audit==2.10.1
